The '''''Annals of Statistics''''' is a peer-reviewed statistics [[Academic journal|journal]] published by the [[Institute of Mathematical Statistics]]. It was started in 1973 as a continuation in part of the ''[[Annals of Mathematical Statistics]] (1930)'', which was split into the ''Annals of Statistics'' and the ''[[Annals of Probability]]''.<ref>{{Cite web|title=The Annals of Statistics on JSTOR|url=https://www.jstor.org/journal/annalsstatistics|access-date=2021-11-08|website=jstor.org|language=en}}</ref>

The journal [[CiteScore]] is 5.8, and its [[SCImago Journal Rank]] is 5.877, both from 2020.<ref>{{Cite web|title=Scopus preview – Scopus – Annals of Statistics|url=https://www.scopus.com/sourceid/13649|access-date=2021-11-08|website=scopus.com}}</ref>

Articles older than 3 years are available on [[JSTOR]], and all articles since 2004 are freely available on the [[arXiv]].

== Editorial board ==
The following persons have been editors of the journal:<ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} Past Editors of IMS Publications|url=https://imstat.org/past-editors-of-ims-journals/|access-date=2021-11-08|language=en}}</ref>

* [[Ingram Olkin]] (1972–1973)	
* I. Richard Savage (1974–1976)	
* [[Rupert G. Miller]] (1977–1979)
* [[David Hinkley|David V. Hinkley]] (1980–1982)
* Michael D. Perlman (1983–1985)
* [[Willem van Zwet]] (1986–1988)
* Arthur Cohen (1988–1991)
* [[Michael Woodroofe]] (1992–1994)
* [[Lawrence D. Brown|Larry Brown]] and John Rice (1995–1997)
* [[Hans-Rudolf Künsch]] and [[Jim Berger (statistician)|James O. Berger]] (1998–2000)
* John Marden and [[Jon A. Wellner]] (2001–2003)
* Morris Eaton and [[Jianqing Fan]] (2004–2006)
* [[Susan Murphy]] and [[Bernard Silverman]] (2007–2009)
* [[Peter Bühlmann]] and [[T. Tony Cai]] (2010–2012)
* [[Peter Gavin Hall|Peter Hall]] and [[Runze Li]] (2013–2015)
* Ed George and Tailen Hsing (2016–2018)
* [[Richard Samworth|Richard J. Samworth]] and Ming Yuan (2019–2021)
* Enno Mammen and Lan Wang (2022–2024)<ref>{{Cite web|title=Institute of Mathematical Statistics {{!}} New IMS Journal Editors|url=https://imstat.org/2021/07/17/new-ims-journal-editors/|access-date=2021-11-08|language=en}}</ref>
* Hans-Georg Müller and Harrison Zhou (2025–2027)
